box: gh#60 DoD box 1 — the roll button is DISABLED before any tap when the range is wider than the cap (10000), and stays ENABLED for a valid range
method: Real build served with `npx serve dist/ -l 4321`, driven with real headless Chrome (`--headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --remote-debugging-port=9222`) via `node scripts/driver.mjs` against a one-off probe script (not committed — throwaway, per the brief's 'only file you may create' constraint). Probe navigates to /tool/number/, wipes localStorage on-origin, reloads, then for each case sets #number-min and #number-max via .value + a real dispatched 'input' Event (not setting .value alone, which does not fire the island's render()), and reads #number-go.disabled and #number-note.textContent BEFORE any tap. For the wide-range case, also computes the button's real screen coordinates and drives session.tap(x, y) — a real touchstart+touchend through Input.dispatchTouchEvent, not elementFromPoint+.click() — then re-reads disabled state, note text, and result text, and checks session.consoleErrors for any exception.
capturedAtCommitNote: Tree was DIRTY at capture. Uncommitted at the time of the run: src/pages/tool/number.astro (modified), src/tools/number.test.mjs (modified), src/tools/number.ts (modified), and src/tools/gh60-control.test.mjs (untracked). PROVENANCE CORRECTION, same session: that control file was moved to docs/verification/evidence/60/box4-control.test.mjs while this probe was running, so the path named above no longer resolves. It was accurate at capture; it is recorded rather than rewritten, because the tree this probe actually ran against is the one described here. The control file is unrelated to the rendered-page behaviour measured in this box either way — it never shipped in dist/. dist/ was built from this dirty tree, so the running page reflects the fix under test, not clean HEAD 4b63f92.
